description: Provenance figure: dN/dS for both paralog lineages, matched-tissue expression, and genomic arrangement on chromosome I
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
dd=pd.read_csv("dnds.csv"); loc=pd.read_csv("gene_loci.csv"); ex=pd.read_csv("exon_structure.csv")
m=pd.read_csv("bgee_expression.csv").drop_duplicates(subset=["score_abhd11_2","score_abhd11_1"])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14.5,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
sub=dd[dd.omega.notna()]
ax.bar(["abhd-11.2\nCel vs Cbr","abhd-11.1\nCel vs Cbr"],sub.omega,color=["#4C72B0","#C44E52"],width=.55)
for i,v in enumerate(sub.omega): ax.text(i,v+0.004,f"{v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(1,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax.set_ylim(0,0.16); ax.set_ylabel("dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori, JC corrected)")
ax.set_title("a  Both copies under strong purifying selection\n(neutral expectation dN/dS = 1, off scale)",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
for _,r in m.iterrows(): ax.plot([0,1],[r.score_abhd11_2,r.score_abhd11_1],"-o",color="#777",ms=4,alpha=.8)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["abhd-11.2","abhd-11.1"]); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_ylabel("Bgee expression score")
ax.set_title("b  abhd-11.2 is the dominant transcript\n10 distinct tissue pairs, Wilcoxon p = 0.002, median 3.1x",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

ax=axes[2]
ax.set_xlim(11.3,12.4); ax.set_ylim(0,1)
for _,r in loc.iterrows():
    c="#4C72B0" if "11.2" in r.gene else "#C44E52"
    y=0.62 if r.strand==-1 else 0.34
    ax.annotate("", xy=((r.end if r.strand==1 else r.start)/1e6,y), xytext=((r.start if r.strand==1 else r.end)/1e6,y),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color=c,lw=4))
    ax.text((r.start+r.end)/2e6, y+0.09 if r.strand==-1 else y-0.14, r.gene.split()[0], ha="center", fontsize=9, color=c)
ax.annotate("", xy=(12.182,0.5), xytext=(11.516,0.5), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->",color="grey"))
ax.text(11.85,0.52,"666 kb",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("chromosome I position (Mb, WBcel235)")
ax.set_title("c  Dispersed, opposite-strand paralogs\nexons: abhd-11.2 = 6, abhd-11.1 = 4",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
